name: How do I choose whether to repair drywall before starting a larger interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose whether to repair drywall before starting a larger interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your home has settled or had doors swing open into walls, look for doorknob indentations, corner bead dents, or popping drywall screws. Walk through each room and hallway, inspecting baseboards, stairwells, and ceiling joints where minor impact or settling commonly happens. Making a consolidated list of every scuff, crack, and hole allows your contractor to address all repairs in a single scheduled visit alongside other finish carpentry or trim work, saving time and keeping project costs lower.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing existing drywall flaws before remodeling or full-room painting ensures clean, unified walls. It is best to fix all dents and settling cracks before applying finish coats.
